mapper.select: SELECT mr.*, u.real_name AS teacher_name, st.student_name AS student_name, st.student_code AS student_number, CASE WHEN mr.question_id < 0 THEN CAST(-mr.question_id AS CHAR) ELSE pq.question_no END AS question_no, (SELECT image_url FROM answer_sheet_image WHERE answer_sheet_id = mr.answer_sheet_id LIMIT 1) AS answer_image_url, (SELECT image_url FROM answer_sheet_image WHERE answer_sheet_id = mr.answer_sheet_id LIMIT 1) AS original_image_url FROM marking_record mr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON mr.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN student st ON mr.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN paper_question pq ON mr.question_id = pq.id WHERE mr.id = #{id}

SELECT mr.*, u.real_name AS teacher_name, st.student_name AS student_name, st.student_code AS student_number, CASE WHEN mr.question_id < 0 THEN CAST(-mr.question_id AS CHAR) ELSE pq.question_no END AS question_no, (SELECT image_url FROM answer_sheet_image WHERE answer_sheet_id = mr.answer_sheet_id LIMIT 1) AS answer_image_url, (SELECT image_url FROM answer_sheet_image WHERE answer_sheet_id = mr.answer_sheet_id LIMIT 1) AS original_image_url FROM marking_record mr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON mr.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN student st ON mr.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN paper_question pq ON mr.question_id = pq.id WHERE mr.task_id = #{taskId} AND mr.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND mr.status = 0 ORDER BY mr.id LIMIT 1

SELECT mr.*, u.real_name AS teacher_name, st.student_name AS student_name, st.student_code AS student_number, CASE WHEN mr.question_id < 0 THEN CAST(-mr.question_id AS CHAR) ELSE pq.question_no END AS question_no, COALESCE(mr.full_score, pq.score) AS full_score, (SELECT image_url FROM answer_sheet_image WHERE answer_sheet_id = mr.answer_sheet_id LIMIT 1) AS answer_image_url, (SELECT image_url FROM answer_sheet_image WHERE answer_sheet_id = mr.answer_sheet_id LIMIT 1) AS original_image_url FROM marking_record mr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON mr.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN student st ON mr.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN paper_question pq ON mr.question_id = pq.id WHERE mr.task_id = #{taskId} AND mr.marking_role = #{markingRole} AND mr.status = 0 ORDER BY mr.skip_count ASC, mr.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT mr.*, u.real_name AS teacher_name, st.student_name AS student_name, st.student_code AS student_number, CASE WHEN mr.question_id < 0 THEN CAST(-mr.question_id AS CHAR) ELSE pq.question_no END AS question_no, (SELECT image_url FROM answer_sheet_image WHERE answer_sheet_id = mr.answer_sheet_id LIMIT 1) AS answer_image_url, (SELECT image_url FROM answer_sheet_image WHERE answer_sheet_id = mr.answer_sheet_id LIMIT 1) AS original_image_url FROM marking_record mr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON mr.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN student st ON mr.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN paper_question pq ON mr.question_id = pq.id WHERE mr.task_id = #{taskId} AND mr.is_problem = 1 ORDER BY mr.create_time DESC
